# Tennis sounds

- `racket-hit.wav`: excerpt from [Tennis Ball being hit](https://freesound.org/people/jacklilley/sounds/338122/) by jacklilley, [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). The short excerpt was obtained from the openly published [WilhelmSFX sample](https://github.com/Wh1teDuke/WilhelmSFX/blob/master/Samples/338122__jacklilley__tennis-ball-being-hit.wav), then mixed to mono, converted to 16-bit PCM, high-pass filtered and faded out.
- `ball-bounce-1.wav` and `ball-bounce-2.wav`: excerpts from [Tennis Ball: Bounce](https://bigsoundbank.com/tennis-ball-bounce-s0584.html) by Joseph Sardin / BigSoundBank, CC0 1.0. The original recording was trimmed to individual impacts, resampled, high-pass filtered and faded.
